folder: Wild Cats Never Need a Dental

shots.vo_line: Wild cats never need a dental.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the woman gently holds the cat's lip up as the red gums pulse with a soft glow; the cat blinks slowly and her whiskers twitch. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Indoor cats get booked in for one, year after year.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the vet gently lifts the cat's lip, the red gums pulsing softly, while the cat blinks and the woman behind watches with a worried look. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: And most owners just accept that without ever asking why.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the woman slowly strokes the cat on her lap, head tilted down calmly, as the red glow below her flickers gently. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: A good cat mum doesn't.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the woman tilts her head slightly towards the cat, who sits still, blinks slowly and flicks her ears, as the lamp light glows softly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: See, in the wild, there's no problem.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the wild cat takes slow, careful steps along the branch with its head low, staying in frame, while leaves sway gently around it. Slow pan right.

shots.vo_line: Bone, gristle, raw prey.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the wild cat slowly gnaws the bone, jaw working steadily and eyes narrowed, its white teeth glinting as ferns sway softly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Every bite scrapes her teeth clean, exactly the way nature intended.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the wild cat's teeth slowly bite down on the bone with a slight jaw tremble, a bright white glow running along the clean teeth. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: But her dinner comes out of a pouch.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the woman slowly squeezes soft food from the pouch into the bowl while the cat watches, ears forward, tail tip twitching. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: And dental biscuits crumble before they do anything.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat slowly bites the biscuit, glowing orange crumbs falling gently to the floor as her jaw moves. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Water additives smell like a chemist's to a nose
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat sniffs the water bowl, nose twitching, as the green haze rises and curls slowly; the people in the window behind stay still. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: 40 times more sensitive than yours.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the green haze curls slowly towards the cat's glowing nostrils, her whiskers twitch and her open mouth trembles slightly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: So the plaque keeps building, hardening,
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat's open mouth trembles slightly, the red-hot gums pulsing with a slow glow around the tartar-crusted teeth. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: until the only tool she has left is her own paw.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat lies on the rug and slowly rubs her paw over her mouth, wincing, eyes half closed, the red gums glowing faintly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: That's when the pawing starts.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat paws at her mouth with small, slow strokes, eyes squeezed shut, the red-hot gums pulsing as she winces. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Vets who see this every week all point to the same fix:
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the vet gently shines the small light into the cat's mouth and leans in a little closer, while the cat holds still and blinks. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: stop fighting her instincts.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat squirms slightly in the woman's hands and turns her head away, staying in place on the rug, while the woman lowers the toothbrush a little. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Give her something she actually eats.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat eats steadily from the bowl, head bobbing gently as she chews, tail resting on the rug. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: After hundreds of iterations,
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the woman slowly taps a little powder from the spoon onto the scale while the man beside her watches; the cat sits still. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: we found one formula that passed every test.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the hand slowly lifts the scoop of powder from the jar, fine grains trickling off its edge with a soft glow, while the cat behind watches. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: That's why we developed Meow Mouth.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the orange rings pulse and turn slowly around the tub while the couple behind gently stroke the cat. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: The moment it goes on her dinner, something shifts.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the woman tips the scoop and powder falls gently onto the wet food while the cat watches. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: She sniffs the bowl, circles it once.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat takes slow steps around the bowl, sniffing its rim, tail swaying gently, staying inside the frame. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Then she tucks in and clears the lot.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat eats hungrily with her face in the bowl, head bobbing, while the couple behind smile and lean in slightly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Not because you put it there.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat licks the empty bowl with slow strokes while the couple behind smile. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Because something in it tells her, this is what I've been looking for.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat slowly licks her lips and blinks with satisfied eyes, sitting still behind her bowl, while the couple in the background smile. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: It's made with brewer's yeast and a bacon flavour,
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the man gently scratches the cat's chin and the bacon floats softly. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: so to her, it smells like the best part of dinner.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat lifts her nose slowly with eyes closed in bliss as the wavy orange glow curls up from the bowl; the couple behind smile. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Once she's eaten it, it comes back out through her saliva,
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: a glowing wave of saliva washes slowly over the cat's teeth, glistening, with a slight jaw tremble. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: so zinc and plant enzymes work on the plaque.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the red-hot tartar crumbles slowly into tiny embers that drift away, and the red glow in the gums cools to soft orange. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: Every single meal does what it's supposed to do.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat eats calmly from the bowl, head moving gently as she chews. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: And because she gets it with every meal,
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: seen from above, the cat eats from the bowl with gentle head movements, tail swaying slowly, as the orange glow ring around the bowl pulses softly. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: the plaque never gets the chance
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the clean white teeth glisten as a faint orange shimmer of saliva moves slowly across them, with a slight jaw tremble. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: to harden into tartar.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat finishes a slow, wide yawn showing clean white teeth, then gently closes her mouth and blinks. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: After a week, her breath is softer.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat yawns slowly near the woman's face while she smiles, chin resting on her hand, and stays close. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: After a month, she lets you near her mouth again.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the woman gently strokes the cat's cheek and the cat leans into her hand with eyes closed, purring. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: That's why she keeps coming back.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat walks slowly a few steps across the rug towards the bowl, tail up, staying inside the frame. Slow pan right.

shots.vo_line: Not because you trained her,
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat sits beside the empty bowl, blinks slowly at the camera and flicks an ear, tail curling gently. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: because the bowl earns it.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the woman gently strokes the sleeping cat, whose side rises and falls slowly. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: We keep getting photos of cats who ignored every dental treat their owner ever bought,
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the family smiles at the phone while the little photo frames float slowly around it in the glow; the cat beside them blinks. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: clearing this bowl within days.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat licks the empty bowl with slow strokes while the couple behind smile. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Owners saying the pawing stopped.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the woman hugs the cat gently and sways slightly, eyes closed in contentment, as the cat nuzzles her cheek. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: This is exactly what we do it for.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat sleeps on the woman's lap, its side rising and falling, while she slowly strokes its back. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Every batch is made by a small team.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the woman slowly tips powder from the scoop into the open tub while the cat watches. The tubs stay completely still with their labels facing the camera. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: The enzyme coating takes time.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the hands slowly turn the powder in the steel drum, tiny golden sparkles rising and drifting, while the cat watches calmly. Slow camera push-in.

shots.vo_line: You simply can't rush it.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the hand rests gently on the lid while the woman behind strokes the cat. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Demand keeps outpacing what we can make.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the man gently strokes the cat while the woman smiles, her hand perfectly still. The tubs stay completely still with their labels facing the camera, lids closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: If you've been waiting, now is the time.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat looks up and blinks slowly while the woman behind strokes the other cat. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera, lid closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Static camera.

shots.vo_line: Right now, it's buy two, get one free.
shots.motion_prompt: Neon wireframe animation: the cat blinks and flicks an ear as the globe glows softly. The tubs stay completely still with their labels facing the camera, lids closed. All text in the frame stays unchanged. Slow camera push-in.
